comparator.instructions: What relation does the text state for the value {value}?

criteria.exact: the text states exactly this amount
criteria.at_most: the amount is an upper limit or maximum
criteria.at_least: the amount is a lower limit or minimum
criteria.more_than: the amount is exceeded: more than or above it
criteria.less_than: below or less than the amount
criteria.old_value: the old value before a change
criteria.new_value: the new value after a change

key.instructions: Which condition does the value {value} belong to?
